settings.label: model
settings.help: The model id as the endpoint lists it. Required. The suggestions are the openrouter lineup this dojo's own fighters run.

settings.label: endpoint
settings.help: Any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint: OpenRouter, a direct provider, or Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: The NAME of the environment variable you keep the key in. qdojo reads it when the bot starts and never writes it down. A local endpoint needs none.

settings.label: timeout (s)
settings.help: Seconds one call may take. Keep it under the bot's --solver-timeout or the bot gives up first.

settings.label: temperature
settings.help: 0 answers the same way every time, which is what a riddle wants.
